parts.covers: Shoppers who did not buy and why they chose another store are not recorded; empty shelf audits are the only recorded stand-in for lost demand.
parts.sql: select "shelf-audits-june"."sku" as "sku", count(*) as "empty_audits" from "shelf-audits-june"  where ((substr(substr("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts",1,10),1,10) >= ?) AND (substr(substr("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts",1,10),1,10) <= ?)) and ("shelf-audits-june"."status" = ?) group by "shelf-audits-june"."sku" order by "empty_audits" desc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where (day(shelf audits.audit_ts) >= '2026-06-01' and day(shelf audits.audit_ts) <= '2026-06-30') and shelf audits.status = 'empty'; group by shelf audits.sku; report sku = shelf audits.sku, empty_audits = count of *; sorted by empty_audits desc.

parts.covers: Expired or damaged stock removed from sale is recorded, but the reason shoppers left for another store is not recorded.
parts.sql: select "write-offs-june"."sku" as "sku", "write-offs-june"."reason" as "reason", sum("write-offs-june"."units") as "units_written_off" from "write-offs-june"  where ((substr(substr("write-offs-june"."date",1,10),1,10) >= ?) AND (substr(substr("write-offs-june"."date",1,10),1,10) <= ?)) group by "write-offs-june"."sku", "write-offs-june"."reason" order by "units_written_off" desc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From write-off records; keep rows where (day(write offs.date) >= '2026-06-01' and day(write offs.date) <= '2026-06-30'); group by write offs.sku, write offs.reason; report sku = write offs.sku, reason = write offs.reason, units_written_off = sum of write offs.units; sorted by units_written_off desc.
